chapter: Chicago and New York with Louis Armstrong, 1925-30
title: Lucille's claim that Zutty took a band from Louis
summary: Marge reports Lucille said Louis never hired Zutty because he would not have another band taken from him; Marge and Dance insist the Dickerson band simply broke up and Zutty stayed at Connie's Inn.

story.theme_name: Working with and around Louis Armstrong
story.community_name: Playing with and around Louis Armstrong

blocks.x: And Now I can tell it the way Louis told Lucille you know when Zutty never worked with Louis any more you know and he never got Zutty in the band. And Lucille told me when we were out there spending the four days with her and she and I were downstairs talking you know. And she said, well you know to tell you the truth, Margie, why Zutty never, Louis never got Zutty (unintelligible), he told me once that he wasn't going to have Zutty take another band away from him. I said, now what do you mean? I said now what do you mean that Zutty took a band away from Louis? She said, when they first came to New York. And I said, I said, now listen, I'm going upstairs and get this
straight with Louis right in front of Zutty. She said, oh no, no. Don't disturb him no, no, no and given him an attack. Let him stay quiet and all.
And I said, but Lucille, that's a lie. And I said Zutty would have played for nothing as long as he could be with Louis.
No, but I mean that's obviously wrong because the Carroll Dickerson band broke up and went back to Chicago and you went with Ally Ross.

Yes, but because Zutty stayed at Connie's Inn he thought well Zutty took the band over. That's what he told Lucille and I told Lucille I said, let's go up there now, I said that's the biggest lie that could ever be told. She said that's what Pops told me that he wasn't going to have Zutty take another band away. I said, take a band, I said, listen Lucille, I said, I'll tell you just how I felt. I said, Zutty was so crazy about Louis and loved Louis so much, I told her in plain words, I said, I have to tell Zutty all the time, he don't give a shit about you, so forget about him I get sick of you talking about Louis, Louis, Louis.
Well I suppose you know to sort of put it mildly in a way, the success had gone to his head somewhat. I mean that's human.
You know and I mean and then people would be talking to him you know, about the money he could make.

That's why Louis wanted to make his piece with Zuddy before he passed away because he had treated Zuddy very poorly. Very badly. And lied on Zuddy. I'm sorry, God rest his soul, I loved Louis. Oh I loved Louis so much. But to tell his wife that. And that is the impression she's under.

And I didn't tell Zuddy about it until we got home. Got back to New York. Because she begged me. But I said, I'd like to get this straight. She said, oh no, she said, they're having such a good time together.

And then she said another thing. And then Louis said Zuddy couldn't make it with the band anyway because when they'd go to Los Vegas and the'd throw that music on them and all of that you have to read and all. And I said, the show Zuddy's playing, I said that's his line, like Zuddy could play any kind of show. Like Zuddy, like Louis wasn't going to let Zuddy take another band away
from him. I said, that's the biggest lie that could ever be.
